summary: The popover attribute and the <dialog> element show content on top of the page. A button with popovertarget opens a popover with no JavaScript. A <dialog> holds a focused task like a confirmation or a short form.
notes: Click "Where is Room 2115?" in the preview to open the popover. Click outside it or press Esc to close it.
<dialog open> shows the dialog as part of the page. To show it as a modal that blocks the rest of the page, JavaScript must call showModal(), so that is not in this preview.

<form method="dialog"> closes the dialog when one of its buttons is clicked, with no JavaScript. The preview may block forms, so the RSVP buttons can do nothing there; on a normal page they close the dialog.
pitfall: Writing popovertarget="#room-info" with a #. The value is the plain id, room-info, or the button does nothing.
